kb.a: Sam's lane starts with scanning the WhatsApp code and restoring the CRM login; both sessions are logged out. Then confirm the Atlas formula and packaging, decide on the manual-ads revert, and price the Spanish-language custom-cream inquiry. Terra Lotus remains Aidan's customer-communication lane.

Aidan owns all Terra Lotus customer communication and owes the revised higher-volume, lower-per-unit pricing. Once WhatsApp is restored, he needs a concrete update that day; two business days of silence triggers escalation to Sam. He is not authorized to leave this unanswered.

Terra Lotus is a $78,580 negotiation owned by Aidan. The customer asked for a lower unit price at higher quantities after receiving tier pricing, so the next move is Aidan's revised-volume response. WhatsApp being logged out blocks the immediate nudge, not the deal ownership.

Atlas Eternal is $26,500 and its $13,250 deposit is paid. The formula must be confirmed received and packaging locked before production begins; then set the $13,250 completion-balance follow-up. The previous contract/docs question is moot because payment landed.
Oreka is an $8,555 closed deal already in production. Laura owns customer communication. It is a production follow-through item, not a new-sales chase.

Pure Good is roughly a $329,000 opportunity tied to the same Kenna meeting gate. It advances when the Kenna follow-up is resolved and a next commercial step is scheduled. Do not present it as closed or production-ready.

A Spanish-speaking website lead wants 100 units of a 1.7-ounce custom cream with retinol, hyaluronic acid, collagen, and niacinamide. Sam already replied, and the open loop is a price. Provide pricing to close the conversation without overstating a commitment.

Nikkie is actively handling a large weekend batch of website brand-development inquiries, including one sourced directly from ChatGPT. This is healthy top-of-funnel activity. Watch for qualification and booked calls before assigning revenue value.

The Production Pipeline CRM build is approved and queued for execution. It should be executed only when Sam says go. The CRM session is currently logged out, so live verification remains blocked until Sam restores it.

WhatsApp and the CRM are both logged out today. Restoring WhatsApp unblocks the client sweep and Terra Lotus follow-up; restoring CRM access unblocks fix verification and operational lookup. Neither session should be described as connected until reauthenticated.

The ads are spending about $29 a day against the approved $30 daily cap, with no conversion tracking and both scoped campaigns still bidding blind. The standing recommendation is to revert both campaigns to Manual CPC. No change occurs without Sam's explicit approval.

Laura owns Oreka customer communications, white/private-label bottle-printing coordination, and NDAs. Her simpler dedicated assistant is built, but her email, WhatsApp, and CRM connections still await Sam's setup. Keep her focused on active customer operations and documentation.

Ronald supplies formula and BOM cost inputs where needed. His costing work must include the requested inputs before any quote is issued, and no quote should rely on a BOM alone. There is no new Ronald completion recorded in this refresh.

Darlene Saintil has a luxury hand lotion and hand wash discovery meeting scheduled for Wednesday, August 19 at 4 PM. The concept is clean, sensitive-skin-friendly hand care with a defined budget. Prepare the discovery context; no outcome is recorded yet.
Tesfa Shiferaw at Bahrzaf has a shampoo and conditioner project and was scheduled to speak with Sam on Monday. Treat it as an active discovery conversation. No meeting result has been recorded yet.

Ashley Harmon at Apothik Skin remains a warm prospect for a postbiotic moisturizer and balm project at one to three thousand units per SKU. She had said she would send next-week call times. Keep the lead warm and wait for a scheduled time rather than claiming it is booked.

Tasnim Broud at AYYUR is considering a ritual-oil package with a 30 mL frosted glass bottle and gold dropper/cap. She is open to PLL sourcing and has not selected a vendor. The commercial path is to move toward prototype quantities once packaging direction is confirmed.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance is interested in 4,000-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion using his own fragrance oil. The next qualification points are formula, tube packaging, and timing. No new response is recorded in this refresh.
